independentReview.scope: Exact candidate same-code original CI/DB/package evidence and downloaded-runtime SDK audit. Original candidate packages are historical after this evidence freeze; no final source CI or public release is signed.

completionPolicy: passed/releaseReady here record completed technical same-code validation only. Final package regeneration, final exact frozen-source CI, public download verification, participant/human actions and organizer acceptance are not completed by this declaration.
releaseReadyScope: Completed technical same-code evidence freeze only; final regenerated archives, new frozen-source CI, owner review and public downloads remain separate pending gates.

finalPackage.reason: Rebuild source and portable archives after final evidence and metadata edits; verify fresh consumers and final exact SHA256SUMS.

finalExactSourceCI.reason: Create the final frozen-source commit after owner review; require successful exact-head original push general and PostgreSQL CI.
